title: Manifest append-only chain hardening
current_problem: Manifest uses upsert overwrite semantics, so ledger is not fully append-only.
proposal: Introduce evidence-manifest/2.0 append log with sequence+prev_hash and fail-closed chain verification at read time.
expected_gain: Tamper-evidence and forensic traceability become auditable end-to-end.

title: Durable progress monotonicity
current_problem: Cycle/stop/degraded state is in-memory Map/Set and can reset after restart.
proposal: Persist progress-ledger with CAS semantics keyed by session+message and restore on process boot.
expected_gain: Deterministic rerun and hard-stop continuity across restarts and multi-instance runs.
risk: Potential contention under high concurrency if CAS poorly designed.

title: Bind verification with real contextPackId
current_problem: secure-output verification task frame uses contextPackId=unknown.
proposal: Thread lastContextPackId from ContextLedger into runVerification taskFrame and block when unknown in strict mode.
expected_gain: Audit chain continuity and deterministic replay confidence improve materially.
risk: Minor plumbing changes across session to secure-output boundaries.

title: DeepSeek sampling profile governance
current_problem: DeepSeek reasoning sanitization exists but temperature/top_p policy is not explicitly profiled.
proposal: Add provider/model+intent profiles (strict/light) for temperature/top_p/max_tokens with config override and event observability.
expected_gain: Lower schema drift and better long-session stability for DeepSeek workloads.
risk: Over-tuning may reduce creativity in non-strict tasks.

title: Make v16 deepseek thinking behaviorally effective
current_problem: v16DeepseekThinking is resolved in rollout but lacks explicit behavior-level strategy branches and outcome metrics.
proposal: Implement concrete branches gated by v16DeepseekThinking and emit per-branch outcome events for A/B verification.
expected_gain: Transforms rollout flag from metadata to measurable product impact.
risk: Branch explosion if not constrained to key decision points.

title: Reference gate default-surface tightening
current_problem: Strict fail-closed is strong but primarily intent-gated and not fully default for ambiguous evidence-heavy tasks.
proposal: Promote strict mode for high-risk categories and add confidence-based escalation from light to strict.
expected_gain: Reduces hallucinated citations in mixed-intent long sessions.

title: Cross-module probe correlation
current_problem: Retrieval probe journal and compaction delta both exist but cross-module correlation IDs are limited.
proposal: Add unified probe_correlation_id across retrieval/compaction/secure-output events and artifacts.
expected_gain: Faster root-cause isolation for drift and replay incidents.
risk: Schema bump and dashboard update effort.

title: Compaction consistency metrics
current_problem: Current quality metrics focus on semantic coverage and known/unknown counts, not contradiction consistency.
proposal: Extend compaction.quality with contradiction_rate and anchor_consistency_score validated against reference-check outcomes.
expected_gain: Improves long-horizon summary trustworthiness beyond coverage-only metrics.
risk: Metric design may require iterative calibration.

title: Long-session restart soak suite
current_problem: Most current evidence is targeted unit/scenario tests; restart+multi-hour soak evidence is limited.
proposal: Add nightly soak tests covering restart resume monotonicity, strict reference gate, and assisted compaction guardrails.
expected_gain: Raises confidence for production long-session stability claims.
risk: Longer CI duration and flakiness management needed.

title: Unified GO evidence pack automation
current_problem: Specialized reports exist but no single automated final gate package for release decision.
proposal: Generate one consolidated GO pack with P0/P1 metrics, replay traces, and external mapping checklist.
expected_gain: Faster and less subjective release decisioning.
